book_title: The Heroin Diaries: A Year in the Life of a Shattered Rock Star
author: Nikki Sixx
book_description: The Heroin DiariesIn the late '80s, during the heyday of Motley Crue, he confesses his days of addiction to not only heroin, but also cocaine and alcohol. He recounts his hatred for his biological parents who abandoned him, his relationships that were only held together by drugs, the pain of rehabilitation, and his return to the path of drug addiction... This is a realistic diary of his time as a heavy addict.Show more
